w:r.w:t: # System Requirements Document (SRD) for Mbole Pay

Mbole Pay is a web-based platform designed to digitize and automate community savings groups ("njangi" or "tontine") by leveraging smart contracts, automated payments, and transparent record-keeping. This document outlines the functional and non-functional requirements for the system.
- Enable digital management of community savings groups.
- Automate transactions, contributions, and payouts using smart contracts.
- Provide secure and transparent financial tracking.
- Support dispute resolution through anonymous voting.
- Offer an accessible, scalable, and secure platform for tontines.
* Members of savings groups (individuals, businesses, cooperatives).
* Engineers responsible for system implementation and maintenance.
- Users can register via email, phone number, or social login.
- Admins can approve or reject member applications.
- Members: Can contribute, view transactions, and vote on disputes.
- Admins: Can create groups, manage members, and oversee financial transactions.
- Super Admins: Platform-wide management and compliance monitoring.
- Admins can create savings groups with customizable rules.
- Members can join/leave groups based on eligibility.
- Automated record-keeping of all member contributions.
- Real-time tracking of total group savings and individual balances.
- Auto-debit for scheduled contributions via smart contracts.
- First-come, first-paid system based on agreed payout sequence.
- Members can raise disputes and vote on resolutions.
- SMS/email alerts for payments, dues, disputes, and payouts.
Simple, intuitive interface suitable for users with varying digital literacy.
Use of clear icons and minimal text where possible.
Fast loading times on typical smartphones used in Cameroon.
Efficient database queries to handle multiple groups and members.
Ensure data is not lost when connection drops.
Use secure communication (e.g., HTTPS) between app and server.
Protect against unauthorised access, data tampering, and fraud.
Able to support growing number of users and groups over time.
Modular architecture to allow future updates and feature additions.
* Ethereum or Binance Smart Chain (for smart contracts).
- Smart contract execution fees (gas fees) must be optimized.
- Mobile money integration depends on regional providers.
- Users have access to smartphones or computers.
- Tontine groups are willing to adopt digital solutions.
- AI-based fraud detection for abnormal transactions.
- Decentralized Identity (DID) for enhanced member verification.
This document serves as the foundational blueprint for the development of Mbole Pay. Further refinements will be made based on user feedback and regulatory requirements.
